result.decisiveNextEvidence: A bounded, read-only reproduction of the no-Tool structured-result Run showing exactly which Harness-owned control/state transition caused the misclassified correction event at the ToolBridge boundary — resolving whether the defect is in correction handling, control-state propagation, or a startup/Terminal-condition interaction.
result.reason:
H-NOTOOL is the highest-information, highest-urgency frontier: a real, observed misclassification at a Harness-owned boundary (correction/control handling terminated at ToolBridge incorrectly) that is reproducible and falsifiable. The evidence would resolve a genuine correctness gap in the Harness core — not a marginal optimization or an experiment awaiting external actors. The exact causal control/state interaction is currently unknown, so a bounded reproduction could materially change the frontier now.

S-UNKNOWN is also narrow and patch-relevant (security adapter representation gap) but its evidence path is explicitly not yet closed. R-WITNESS is prevention-adjacent with an adversarial experiment but the P3 witnesses already fail closed, so the delta is marginal.

H-DISCOVERY is a valuable efficiency study but asks about observation-count optimization, not a correctness defect — its 203-observation result already proved the discovery authority works. HOST-PKG is an effort/cleanliness question with no correctness or security stakes. G-HUMAN and F-LIVE are deferred not for lack of value but because they depend on external actors (humans / independent executor) and real-capital consequences respectively, making them conditionally actionable rather than immediately decisive.
